facts.fact: Attorney General Al-Siddiq Al-Sour says a team comparing national ID system data with the civil status registry found discrepancies that led to deletion of more than 17,000 non-existent national ID numbers and nearly 40,000 linked salary numbers.
facts.system: national ID system / civil status registry

LBY.note: Civil registry offices are audited, but no digital civil registration system is stated.
No count or share of people holding a national ID is given.
No number at birth is mentioned.
The document says nothing on who operates, maintains or owns the ID system.

facts.fact: Attorney General Al-Siddiq Al-Sour says checking national ID numbers led to deletion of more than 17,000 non-existent ID numbers along with nearly 40,000 salary numbers that had been linked to them.
The Attorney General says national identification numbers are recorded in state databases, with a national ID system whose data was compared against the civil status registry.

LBY.note: An audit of civil registry records; no digital entry at registry offices is described.
